learnt. She is learnt to have al-

Charan Majhi visited AIIMS

dent is admitted, and promised
all possible help.

authorities, the student had also
approached the police, which in
turn had asked the institute for
aresponse,
Balasore Superintendent of
Police Raj Prasad said Saturday
